evaluation.title: Supplier evaluation
evaluation.noLots: No inspected lot in this period: not scored yet.
evaluation.suggestion: The score suggests the standing «{status}»; whoever approves suppliers decides.
evaluation.formula: Score = % of lots released in full − points for non-conformance reports (critical 10, major 5, minor 2; at most 30) − 1 point per 1,000 of their cost (at most 20). A ≥ 90, B ≥ 75, C ≥ 60, D below.
